item.title: ‘Mardaani 3’ And The Limits Of The “Strong Female Cop” Narrative
item.description: 'Mardaani 3' directed by Abhiraj Minawala and produced by YRF, is a competent, occasionally unsettling, but ultimately cautious film. The post ‘Mardaani 3’ And The Limits Of The “Strong Female Cop” Narrative appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: An Intersectional Feminist Analysis Of The Union Budget 2026-27
item.description: This intersectional analysis of the 2026-27 Union Budget focuses on how women and girls are recognised within the fiscal framework. The post An Intersectional Feminist Analysis Of The Union Budget 2026-27 appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: “Don’t Post That”: How Family Rules Keep Millions Of Indian Women Silent Online
item.description: For many women, the phone is not fully their own—it comes with family oversight, especially over what they post or view. The post “Don’t Post That”: How Family Rules Keep Millions Of Indian Women Silent Online appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: The Politics Of Hair: Power, Control, And Resistance
item.description: Hair becomes a battleground where patriarchal forces converge to exert control over women's bodies. The post The Politics Of Hair: Power, Control, And Resistance appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Changing The Rules Of Seeing: Sylvia Sleigh’s Male Nudes
item.description: The female gaze, in Sleigh's hands, is inseparable from the ethics of friendship, from networks of reciprocal care that precede and frame the act of representation. The post Changing The Rules Of Seeing: Sylvia Sleigh’s Male Nudes appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: What The 2026 UGC Regulations Revealed About Caste, Merit and Savarna Victimhood
item.description: The decision to halt the UGC regulations is just another attempt at denying basic dignity to Dalits and keeping the caste system in place. The post What The 2026 UGC Regulations Revealed About Caste, Merit and Savarna Victimhood appeared first on Feminism in India.
